observed_defects.description: An isolated host-side restoration of the official FeatureBench hidden test file passed 10 of 12 tests. The two remaining failures show that GenerateJsonSchema.encode_default is absent and rebuild_model_fields loses a default value while rebuilding a forward annotation. The official Docker harness was unavailable, so this is an unofficial offline score rather than the official benchmark result.

The agent stopped after a broad public test run reported 3 failed and 94 passed, yet opened the final answer with 'All interfaces are implemented and verified.' The answer later disclosed the 94/102 result, so the defect is overclaiming completion and accepting known failures rather than fabricating the test count.

The trace contains the broad pytest output with three failures, but the run produced no verification records because absolute-path pytest commands were not classified as verification. The final verification claim was instead supported by narrow smoke-test facts, so the claim support layer missed the strongest conflicting evidence.

pass_to_pass.reason: The macOS host only provides Python 3.9; one official pass-to-pass file fails collection on unsupported typing syntax and two remaining failures are environment compatibility failures.
